slot.brief: First-order decomposition with known rate constant; compute fraction remaining after a given number of half-lives or time to reach a stated percentage completion.

stem: A first-order decomposition has rate constant $0.231\ \text{min}^{-1}$. How long does it take for $87.5\%$ of the reactant to decompose?

verdicts.working: For a first-order reaction, the fraction remaining is 12.5%, so t = ln(8)/0.231 ≈ 9.0 min.

Independent check: For a first-order reaction, the fraction remaining is 12.5%, so t = ln(8)/0.231 ≈ 9.0 min.
solution:
For a first-order reaction, $kt=\ln\left(\dfrac{[A]_0}{[A]_t}\right)$. The fraction remaining is $1-0.875=0.125=\dfrac18$.
$$t=\frac{\ln 8}{0.231}=9.0\ \text{min}$$
